payload.title: Time Semantics
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the process of loading, converting, and analyzing time series data using Pandas and Pyleoclim. It includes steps for loading CO2 concentration data, converting it into a Pandas Series, transforming it into a Pyleoclim Series, and performing spectral analysis.

steps.description: Import all the required libraries for data manipulation and analysis.
steps.title: Import Necessary Packages

steps.description: Load the CO2 concentration data from an Excel file into a Pandas DataFrame and display the first few rows to understand its structure.
steps.title: Load Dataset

steps.description: Ensure the 'Time' column in the DataFrame is in datetime format for accurate time series analysis.
steps.title: Convert Time Column to Datetime

steps.description: Create a Pandas Series from the DataFrame with datetime as the index and CO2 ppm as the values, then plot the series.
steps.title: Create Pandas Series

steps.description: Convert the Pandas Series into a Pyleoclim Series with appropriate metadata and plot it.
steps.title: Create Pyleoclim Series

steps.description: Modify the plotting style using Pyleoclim utilities and re-plot the Pyleoclim Series.
steps.title: Change Plotting Styles

steps.description: Conduct spectral analysis on the Pyleoclim Series using the WWZ method and plot the power spectral density with significance testing.
steps.title: Perform Spectral Analysis
